title: STFT power spectrum (Track B optimized)
description: Short-Time Fourier Transform power spectrum (re²+im², no sqrt). Hann window, 1024-point frames, 75% overlap. Track B: JS uses Math trig; Wasm uses Taylor/Newton approximations. Peak-bin oracle, not per-cell magnitude equality.

inputs.generation: Linear chirp 20Hz to 20kHz over 2s at 48kHz, 96000 Float32 samples

oracle.policy: Per-frame peak bin matches chirp instantaneous frequency ±2 bins. Power values must be finite (no NaN/Inf). Not a per-cell magnitude equality contract.
oracle.floatingPointPolicy: Track B optimized: JS uses f64 Math.sin/cos; Wasm uses f32 Taylor series + Newton sqrt. Algorithmic divergence expected. Peak-bin matching is the correctness gate.
oracle.deadCodeDefense: Peak bin per frame verified against chirp formula. All values checked for finiteness.

work.tolerance: Frames, items, bytes, multiplies, butterflies must match exactly.
